snippet.title: CLUE/CLUEDO | OUT NOW | Official Video Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Join fellow detectives all over the world to gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects and solve the original murder mystery. It’s a fresh take on the iconic board game. Use your skills of deduction to solve the crime and find out who? With what? Where? There are six suspects, six weapons, nine rooms, and only one answer! 

Follow your suspects to stunning international locations, unlocking motives and alibis as you go. Crack each case by the original rules, or approach your inquiry from fresh angles. With new and exclusive styles of investigation you can examine all suspects at the same time, relying on your deductive skills to find the answers! Solve the mystery your way and become the detective you want to be!
